summary: BUG: QuickBooks Export Fails – “Bookkeeping customer not found”
reported_issue: For account Central Iowa Ag & Machinery, transferring a customer transaction to QuickBooks fails with 'Bookkeeping customer not found for name "Jeff Burkley"'. The item appears under Reports > QB Unexported Items (Type: Payment Create, Txn 4625, Customer: Jeff Burkley). Expectation is the integration should auto-create the QuickBooks customer.
expected_after_fix: QuickBooks export should not fail when the bookkeeping customer is missing; the integration should create the customer (or handle it gracefully) so the transaction exports successfully.
steps_i_followed: Reviewed the ticket (its own repro says 'Unable to Reproduce'). It concerns a live QuickBooks Online integration export for the production account Central Iowa Ag & Machinery and a specific unexported transaction (4625 / customer 'Jeff Burkley').

Determined this requires an actively connected QuickBooks company file plus the specific production account's unexported transaction, neither of which exists on the disposable staging shop; a real QB export round-trip against a live QuickBooks tenant is needed to observe the 'Bookkeeping customer not found' error.
actual_now: Not reproducible in the staging test harness. The failure occurs during a live QuickBooks Online export for a specific production merchant/transaction; staging has no connected QuickBooks company with the matching customer/transaction, and the export cannot be exercised against the real 3rd-party integration here. The ticket itself is marked 'Unable to Reproduce'.
notes: Live 3rd-party QuickBooks Online integration, production-account-specific data. Requires a connected QB tenant and the exact unexported transaction to reproduce. Staging session cookies also expired during this batch, preventing QB-unexported endpoint inspection.
